sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: This case tests the scope of Rule 60(b)(1). the side that brought the case argues the rule covers only factual mistakes. The government argues the rule covers all errors.

sections.heading: What each side wants
paragraphs: the side that brought the case wants the Court to limit Rule 60(b)(1) to factual errors.
The government wants the Court to allow Rule 60(b)(1) to cover legal errors.

sections.heading: What each side says
